items.stem: Unit 1 的核心句型「Can you play the guitar?」用于（　）
items.explanation: can 表能力，问会不会弹吉他。问时间用 what time，问地点用 where，问天气用 what's the weather like。

items.stem: —Can he swim? —No, he ____.
items.explanation: 以 Can 开头的问句用 can 或 can't 作答，否定为 can't。doesn't 与 isn't 不能回应情态动词提问。

items.stem: I can ____ the piano, but I can't ____ it well.
items.explanation: 情态动词 can 后一律接动词原形，两空都填 play。加 -ing 或加 to 都不符合 can 的用法。

items.stem: —What club do you want to join? —I want to join the ____ club.
items.explanation: 表示「游泳俱乐部」用动名词 swimming 修饰 club。swim、swims、swam 都不作名词修饰成分。

items.stem: be good at 的意思是（　）
items.explanation: be good at 后接名词或动名词，表示擅长某事。be good for 是对……有益，be good with 是善于应付。

items.stem: She is good ____ telling stories.
items.explanation: 擅长做某事用 be good at，后接动名词 telling。be good for 表益处，with 表善于相处，to 不构成该搭配。

items.stem: —What time do you usually get up? —____ six o'clock.
items.explanation: 具体钟点前用介词 at。in 用于月份、年份、上午等，on 用于具体某天，for 表持续时长。

items.stem: He usually ____ his homework at eight in the evening.
items.explanation: 主语 He 第三人称单数，一般现在时用 does。do 配复数主语，doing 是分词缺助动词，did 是过去式与 usually 不符。

items.stem: —How do you get to school? —I ____ to school by bike.
items.explanation: 主语 I 用动词原形 go。goes 配第三人称单数，going 缺助动词，went 是过去式与一般现在时语境不合。

items.stem: It takes me ten minutes ____ to school.
items.explanation: It takes sb. some time to do sth. 是固定句型，用不定式 to get。其余三项都缺 to 或形式不对。

items.stem: 祈使句「不要在教室里吃东西」的英语是（　）
items.explanation: 否定祈使句用 Don't 加动词原形。Not 不能直接开头，Doesn't 用于第三人称单数陈述，No 后不接动词原形。

items.stem: —____ run in the hallways. —Sorry, Ms. Clark.
items.explanation: 否定祈使句以 Don't 加动词原形开头。Not 不能单独置于句首，Doesn't 与 Isn't 都不是祈使句的否定形式。

items.stem: We must ____ the rules at school.
items.explanation: 情态动词 must 后接动词原形 follow。follows 是第三人称单数，following 是分词，followed 是过去式。

items.stem: 「你为什么喜欢熊猫」的英语是（　）
items.explanation: 实义动词 like 的疑问句用助动词 do，主语 you 配 do 且需倒装。are 不能与 like 连用，does 配第三人称单数。

items.stem: Pandas are ____, so many people like them.
items.explanation: 「所以很多人喜欢」说明原因是可爱，用 cute。scary、dangerous、dirty 都是负面评价，与后半句因果不符。

items.stem: —What is he doing? —He ____ TV.
items.explanation: 现在进行时由 be 加现在分词构成，主语 He 用 is watching。watch 是原形，watches 是一般现在时，watched 是过去式。

items.stem: Look! The children ____ in the river.
items.explanation: Look 提示动作正在进行，用现在进行时 are swimming。swim 与 swims 是一般现在时，swam 是过去式。

items.stem: run 的现在分词是（　）
items.explanation: 重读闭音节且末尾只有一个辅音字母，要双写再加 -ing，得 running。runing 少写 n，runned 与 runs 形式不对。

items.stem: —How's the weather in Kunming? —It's ____.
items.explanation: 回答天气要用形容词 sunny。sun 是名词，suny 拼写少一个 n，sunny day 是名词短语不作表语。

items.stem: It's raining now. You'd better take an ____.
items.explanation: 下雨天要带伞，umbrella 以元音音素开头配 an。sunglasses 用于晴天，T-shirt 与 map 都与下雨无关。

items.stem: —Is there a post office near here? —Yes, ____.
items.explanation: There be 句型的肯定回答用 Yes, there is。there are 与单数主语不符，it is 答非所问，there be 不是完整答语。

items.stem: There ____ some books and a pen on the desk.
items.explanation: There be 句型遵循就近原则，靠近的是复数 books，用 are。is 与复数不符，have 与 has 不能表示存在。

items.stem: The pay phone is ____ the post office and the library.
items.explanation: 两者之间用 between…and…。among 用于三者以上，in 与 through 不构成这一搭配。

items.stem: —What does he look like? —He ____ of medium height.
items.explanation: 身高用 be 动词加 of medium height。has 用于描述头发等身体部位，have 与单数主语不符，are 数不对。

items.stem: She has long ____ hair.
items.explanation: 形容词 curly 直接修饰 hair。curls 是名词复数，curling 是分词，curled 是过去式，都不作前置定语。

items.stem: —What would you like? —I'd like some ____.
items.explanation: noodle 常用复数 noodles，some 后接复数可数名词。其余三项的单数或所有格形式都不合用法。

items.stem: 「你想要多大碗的面条」的英语是（　）
options: How many bowl noodles would you like?
What size noodles would you like?
How much noodles would you like?
What size bowl of noodles would you like?
items.explanation: 问尺寸用 What size bowl of noodles。省掉 bowl 结构不完整，how much 问价格或数量，how many 搭配错误。

items.stem: —How was your school trip? —It ____ great.
items.explanation: 问句用 was 问过去，答语也用 was。is 是现在时，are 与 were 用于复数，与主语 It 不搭配。

items.stem: We ____ a lot of photos on the school trip last week.
items.explanation: last week 是过去时间，用过去式 took。take 与 takes 是一般现在时，taking 是分词缺助动词。

items.stem: —Did you see any cows? —Yes, I ____.
items.explanation: 以 Did 开头的问句用 did 作答。do 配一般现在时，was 与 were 是 be 动词的过去式，不能回应行为动词提问。

items.stem: —What did you do last weekend? —I ____ my grandparents.
items.explanation: last weekend 要求过去式 visited。visit 与 visits 是现在时，visiting 是分词缺助动词。

items.stem: 下面哪个动词的过去式是 stayed（　）
items.explanation: 元音字母加 y 结尾的动词直接加 -ed，stay 变 stayed。stays 是第三人称单数，staying 是现在分词，均非过去式。

items.stem: I ____ my homework last night.
items.explanation: last night 是过去时间，用过去式 did。do 与 does 是现在时，doing 是分词不能单独作谓语。

items.stem: There ____ a lot of rain last summer.
items.explanation: last summer 是过去，rain 不可数，用 was。is 是现在时，are 与 were 需要复数主语。

items.stem: —Where did you go on vacation? —I ____ to the mountains.
items.explanation: 问句用 did 表过去，答语用过去式 went。go 与 goes 是现在时，going 是分词缺助动词。

items.stem: 「请安静」的英语表达最恰当的是（　）
items.explanation: 祈使句用 be 动词原形开头，Ae quiet。are 是陈述形式，do 后不能直接接形容词，缺谓语动词则不成立。

items.stem: —What did you ____ for lunch yesterday? —I ate some noodles.
items.explanation: did 后须接动词原形 eat，过去时已由 did 承担。ate 是过去式不能与 did 连用，eaten 是过去分词，eating 是分词。

items.stem: —Excuse me, is there a bank near here? —____, I don't know.
items.explanation: 不知道时应先致歉，用 Sorry。Yes 表示肯定有，Thanks 用于致谢，OK 表示同意，都与后句矛盾。

items.stem: My father usually ____ up at six.
items.explanation: 主语 My father 第三人称单数，一般现在时用 gets。get 配复数主语，getting 缺助动词，got 是过去式。

items.stem: —What are you doing now? —下列答句中正确的是（　）
items.explanation: now 提示现在进行时，须由 be 加现在分词构成。am watch 混用形式，缺 be 或误用第三人称单数都不成立。
